Title: Christmas concert hair in minutes: three easy, free hairstyles for girls
Description: Easy Christmas hairstyles for kids, for a school concert or a party, each made from one simple style: a half-up, half-down with a ribbon or bow, a high ponytail with a ribbon, and two even pigtails with ribbons. Each takes 4 to 6 minutes, and every step is free on Dad Hair Hero, written for anyone who hasn't done much hair. Free, privacy-friendly app for iPhone and Android, with no account.
